title: Event Loop Phases, libuv, Microtasks vs Macrotasks
trackerTask: Event loop phases, libuv, microtasks vs macrotasks
definition: Node.js single JS thread par non-blocking I/O chalata hai libuv event loop aur priority queues ke zariye.

keyPoints.title: 6 Fixed Phases
keyPoints.description: Timers, pending, idle/prepare, poll, check aur close ek fixed round me execute hote hain.

keyPoints.title: Microtasks First
keyPoints.description: Har macrotask ke baad pehle process.nextTick aur Promise queues poori drain hoti hain.

keyPoints.title: libuv Worker Offload
keyPoints.description: Network sockets kernel epoll ko jaate hain; files aur crypto libuv thread pool sambhalta hai.

recap: Node.js ka event loop single thread par non-blocking I/O chalata hai libuv ke 6 phases (timers, pending, idle/prepare, poll, check, close) ke zariye. Microtasks (process.nextTick aur Promises) har macrotask aur phase transition ke beech turant drain hote hain.

demos.title: Call Stack & GEC: Hoisting before execution
demos.summary: Memory creation phase me var undefined aur let/const TDZ me rehte hain. Line-by-line execution se stack frames push/pop hote hain.

demos.title: Node Architecture: Thread pool vs Kernel async
demos.summary: Network sockets kernel (epoll/kqueue) ko jaate hain bina thread pool ke; fs, crypto aur dns.lookup 4 worker threads ko use karte hain.

demos.title: Event Loop Phases: The 6-stage ring
demos.summary: Timers → Pending → Idle/Prepare → Poll → Check → Close. Har stage me sirf us phase ke callbacks execute hote hain.

demos.title: Microtasks vs Macrotasks: nextTick drains first
demos.summary: Har callback ke baad pehle poori nextTick queue drain hoti hai, phir Promise microtasks, aur tab agla macrotask chalta hai.

demos.title: Predict the Output: Execution order puzzles
demos.summary: Apna prediction check karo: setTimeout vs setImmediate, microtasks priority aur async/await ordering compare karo.

demos.title: Breaking the Loop: Freeze, starvation & saturation
demos.summary: Sync infinite loop event loop ko freeze karta hai, recursive nextTick I/O starve karta hai, aur pool saturation fs calls delay karti hai.
